The stated K is exactly the input/output reflection of G.
At epsilon = 0.000173428163029, the displayed weights are nonnegative and the coefficients of both R1 and R2 sum algebraically to one.
The binary-input posterior mutual-information identities and the relaxation to mass, mean, and martingale constraints are valid.
Conditional on the certificate inequalities, auxiliary-channel prior coefficients and total affine slope cancel, leaving a concave reflection-symmetric prior bound maximized at q0 = 1/2.
Selecting either branch of a converse bound of the form R <= min{A,B}, and adding a nonnegative side-condition expression to an upper-bound combination, have the correct inequality direction.
The verifier design appears plausibly fail-closed from static inspection, but static inspection does not certify that every interval cell and tiny positive margin passed.
If the stated final enclosure is established, its upper endpoint is below 0.369296945969202842443, so the boxed rounded bound follows.
The asserted final endpoint is strictly below the preceding repaired-certificate value, so strict improvement follows conditional on both numerical certificates.
The repaired source uses the asserted group-b intercept 10^-33; exact zero-backoff feasibility is not established.

For the displayed quotient point, the normalization 2s_B+s_C+s_D+s_E=1 follows directly.

evidenceIssues: No declared reference supplies or proves the precise Gohari–Liu–Nair Theorem 9 converse needed for the capacity claim.

No pinned or objective terminal execution attests the reported PASS result, the 136 interval-cell checks, the very small margins, or the stated high-precision enclosure for U.

The claims that the materials are four accepted artifacts and verbatim or byte-identical copies from specified commits lack judgment records, source-commit byte attestations, hashes, or terminal comparisons.

excludedAssessments.summary: The compound claim is indeterminate. The local checker establishes exact normalized equality between the JSON-derived private-message rows and make_path_rows(), including the 30-row count, and the single-output audit validly supports preservation under input-only product marginalization conditional on the local transcription and factorization. The Q0 reduction is also supported: all receiver-dependent row terms reduce to (c,g,k,c), and the Q0 feasible set is nonempty. However, no declared primary-source evidence was supplied, so fidelity to Gohari–Liu–Nair Theorem 9—including its factorization, equations (19a)–(19p), and side conditions—cannot be certified. In addition, the general V_Q assertion has an unresolved empty-feasible-set convention, so V_Q may be undefined as stated for some Q,G,K.
scopeQualifications: The 30-row equivalence is established only relative to the locally authored theorem9_spec.json transcription, not the external manuscript.
The row count is 26 expanded inequality branches plus four rows obtained by splitting two interval side conditions.
The checker uses valid finite-minimum expansion and the chain rules I(U,W;A)=I(W;A)+I(U;A|W) and I(V,W;A)=I(W;A)+I(V;A|W).
The four side-condition rows in make_path_rows() are hardcoded rather than independently generated by the generic path loops.

Product marginalization preserves the locally transcribed system because all audited output-bearing terms involve only one of Y, G, K, or Z; no term jointly uses G and K or conditions one receiver output on another.
The marginalization conclusion is conditional on completeness and correctness of the local transcription and stated factorization.
Whenever V_Q is defined, V_Q(G,K) <= V(1/2;G,K) <= B(G,K) follows by feasible-set inclusion and the definition of B.
For Q0={0,1/2,1}, J_A(0)=J_A(1)=0, so every audited row depends on receiver channels only through J_Y(1/2), J_G(1/2), J_K(1/2), J_Z(1/2)=(c,g,k,c).
The Q0 feasible set is nonempty, so the claimed channel-invariance and well-definedness of V_Q0 are supported.
The attestation does not establish Theorem 9 itself, any numerical capacity bound, or the authenticity and contents of the cited PDF.
evidenceIssues: No declared reference evidence authenticates or supplies the Gohari–Liu–Nair manuscript.
The verifier was run without --source-pdf and therefore did not inspect or authenticate the claimed primary source.
The PDF URL, byte count, and SHA-256 are unauthenticated contribution metadata.
The script compares two local artifacts and does not check the claimed theorem factorization against the primary source.

For general Q, the contribution does not specify an extended-real convention such as sup(empty set)=-infinity. For example, Q={1/2} can yield an empty feasible set when g differs from c or k differs from c, leaving V_Q undefined as written.

excludedAssessments.summary: The conditional mathematical audit supports the 30-row specialization, input-only product marginalization, the inequalities V_Q(G,K) <= V(1/2;G,K) <= B(G,K), and finiteness and midpoint-parameter dependence of V_0. However, the all-or-nothing source-fidelity assertion remains unresolved because the bounded PDF decoder is not shown to capture every possible text-display mechanism, and the committed file's status as the official source is not independently authenticated.
scopeQualifications: Gohari–Liu–Nair Theorem 9 is taken as a primary-source premise; its coding-theoretic converse is not independently proved.
The verifier establishes exact agreement between its bounded PDF-decoder output and the canonical specification for the checked header, factorization, equations (19a)–(19p), and both side conditions.

Expanding the six three-branch minima, two two-branch minima, equations (19m)–(19p), and two double inequalities correctly yields 30 scalar rows, with normalized information terms agreeing with the independently generated local formulation.

Product marginalization preserves the system because every output-bearing term uses G alone or K alone, never jointly, and no output is conditioned on another output; the required single-output marginals are preserved.
The optimization inequalities hold with the stated extended-real convention sup(empty set)=-infinity.
For Q_0-supported hierarchies, receiver-channel dependence enters only through the midpoint values (c,g,k,c); feasibility is therefore invariant between channel pairs having the same g and k.
The construction W_a=W_b=W_c=X with constant U_j,V_j shows nonemptiness, while individual-rate rows imply 0 <= V_0(g,k) <= 2. Thus V_0 is finite on its natural domain of realizable midpoint pairs.
evidenceIssues: The PDF extractor handles literal strings displayed through Tj and TJ but is not proved fail-closed for quote text-showing operators, text in invoked form XObjects, or other unsupported content operators.

No exhaustive operator and resource whitelist is asserted for the relevant page streams, so equality with the bounded decoder's output does not establish that every displayed theorem component in the PDF was captured.

The attested hash and byte count authenticate the committed bytes internally, but no network retrieval, publisher-origin verification, or source-signature check establishes the provenance descriptor "official".

Because faithful and official source reproduction is an express component of the declared claim, these unresolved extraction and provenance obligations prevent a valid verdict; no decisive mathematical error supports an invalid verdict.

excludedAssessments.summary: Conditional on the structured transcription faithfully representing the visible theorem, the audit establishes the R0=0 specialization and exact 30-row equivalence, the input-only product marginalization of G and K, the extended-real inequalities V_Q(G,K) <= V(1/2;G,K) <= B(G,K), and the finite well-definedness of V_0(g,k) on its realizable domain. However, the declared all-or-nothing claim also requires a fail-closed, render-complete audit of the visible PDF, and the supplied checker does not validate actual Type1 glyph outlines or fully establish visual legibility and non-occlusion. With no counterexample to the pinned PDF, this unresolved source-fidelity obligation makes the claim indeterminate rather than invalid.
scopeQualifications: Gohari–Liu–Nair Theorem 9 is taken as a premise and is not independently re-proved.
The R0=0 specialization yields 26 inequality rows plus four side-condition rows; the chain-rule normalization used to compare them is valid.
Marginalization is established conditional on completeness of the audited term list: the system has no joint (G,K)-output term and no term conditioning one receiver output on another.
The convention sup(empty set)=-infinity makes the optimization inequalities meaningful for empty support-restricted feasible sets.

For Q0={0,1/2,1}, receiver-channel dependence is only through (J_Y(1/2),J_G(1/2),J_K(1/2),J_Z(1/2))=(c,g,k,c); feasibility is nonempty and zero-branch rate bounds give 0 <= V_0(g,k) <= 2 on the realizable (g,k)-domain.

The terminal attestation authenticates the pinned PDF and verifies its catalog, page structure, content operators, decoded glyph records, structured text comparison, 30 generated rows, and output-term whitelist, but it does not itself prove the theorem’s converse or execute the prose marginalization and optimization arguments; those arguments are separately mathematically sound conditional on transcription fidelity.
evidenceIssues: The checker inventories Type1 CharStrings and authenticates whole font programs by hard-coded digests, but it does not execute or geometrically validate the CharStrings.

Glyph names and ToUnicode mappings do not alone establish that the painted glyph outlines visibly represent the asserted characters; no independently auditable certificate connects the pinned font digests to the claimed outlines.

The geometry checks cover declared font bounding boxes, start positions, page containment, and limited same-baseline monotonicity, but do not establish non-occlusion or semantic legibility of the actual glyph outlines.
Matching a preselected geometry digest authenticates layout data but does not prove the omitted visual predicates required by the claim’s characterization of the audit as render-complete.
